The USDA FoodData Central values in it are public domain (CC0 1.0) and stay so. The derived columns (medians, ranges, differences) are this site's.

methodology: One USDA FoodData Central record per food, chosen by hand and pinned by fdcId: Foundation Foods where it has the food with all four values, SR Legacy otherwise; where Foundation lists only named varieties (apples, mangoes, onions), one variety, named in the label. For Open Food Facts, the first page (10 products) its v2 search returns for the food's category tag with sort_by=unique_scans_n; a product counts when it states energy-kcal, proteins, fat and carbohydrates per 100 g, and the food's Open Food Facts value is the median of the products that count. Differences are (Open Food Facts median minus USDA) divided by USDA, in percent. Open Food Facts is crowd-sourced packaged food: a category holds whatever contributors filed there, and some products state values per 100 ml.
